'), so after `trace.trim()` a suspension marker on the final line of a VM trace was never stripped and got parsed as an extra frame. ' and asserts 2 frames, which is exactly the reported symptom (CHANGELOG: 'Fix bug parsing asynchronous suspension gap markers at the end of stack traces'); it is the unchanged upstream test from the same fixing commit and introduces no new production API.
